einzeiler: Jared Kavlie on live selling and the evolution of Pristine Auction
kurzfassung: Jared Kavlie discusses the growth and evolution of live selling within the collectibles market. He shares insights on popular segments including signed rookie cards, vintage cards, game-used jerseys, and Pokémon TCG. Additionally, he explores future prospects and changing formats for Pristine Auction.
stichpunkte: Rapid evolution of auctions and the collectibles market
Growth of live selling comprising about half of Pristine Auction's sales

beschreibung:
Pristine Auction founder and CEO Jared Kavlie joins Ryan Alford live from The National to talk about the rapid evolution of auctions, live selling, and where he sees opportunity in today’s collectibles market.
Jared explains why live selling has already grown to roughly half of Pristine Auction’s sales, shares the story behind a Michael Jordan signed rookie that sold in the $40Ks, and breaks down why signed vintage cards and game-used jerseys continue to catch his attention.
They also discuss Pokémon, Trade Night at The National, Pristine’s original Days of Thunder car, faster auction formats, and what’s next for Pristine Auction as the hobby continues to evolve.
Topics Covered
Michael Jordan signed rookie
Growth of live selling
Signed vintage cards
Game-used jerseys
Pokémon and TCG
The original Days of Thunder car
Trade Night at The National
10-second auctions
Pristine Auction’s selling model
What’s next for Pristine Auction
